DeterminationBasis: T16-001 establishes the general claim ceiling: a material claim must remain bounded to established evidence and fails if it materially exceeds what the evidence establishes. T16-003 separately rejects unsupported stronger external-status claims including external certification and production-proven representations. Together these controls preserve the WORD-004 boundary that a LILP PASS does not, by itself, establish additional properties such as safety, security, lawfulness, universal ethical status, production readiness, error freedom, immutability, universal trustworthiness or external certification.

T16-014 requires procedure and evidence for PL3, and T16-015 preserves reproduction conditions and result for PL5, but both are proof-level-specific. WORD-005 states a broader generic obligation: whenever an additional property is claimed, each claimed property must have its own supporting evidence and bounded verification method. No existing generic T16 control establishes that property-specific evidence-plus-method obligation across claim classes, so a distinct test is required.
